name: ESTEEM/SER-Quest Summer Program
org: A. James Clark School of Engineering, University of Maryland (Center for Minorities in Science and Engineering)
what_you_do: A 4-week, commuter, research-focused summer program for rising seniors that introduces UMD engineering, research mentoring and the college application process.
who_can_apply: Rising 12th graders with at least a 3.2 GPA and no C's in math or science, who finished Trigonometry, Chemistry and Pre-Calculus with a B or better, want to study engineering at UMD, and can attend full time for all 4 weeks.
pay_detail: No cost to students selected (stated on the page). No stipend is stated.
duration: 4 weeks (Jul 7 to Jul 31 in 2026), commuters only
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application deadline Mar 29, 2026; teacher recommendations due Apr 9, 2026; program Jul 7 to Jul 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Online application with an essay and resume, two teacher recommendations (one math, one science), and a virtual interview with the student and a parent or guardian.
notes: The page says taking part does not guarantee admission to UMD. No housing is offered. A free program, not a job, so no work permit.
